title: soldanella alpina var. minima
intro: Soldanella alpina var. minima, commonly known as Alpine Yellow Soldanella or Dwarf Yellow Soldanella, is a low-growing, perennial plant species belonging to the primrose family (Primulaceae). The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Soldanella alpina var. minima are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
